concerns.text: Teleprompter isolation interceptor matches paths by simple string containment rather than strict route parsing, which could accidentally match valid query params if named similarly.
Design check screenshot files are included under .eneik/records, which will be automatically stripped before merge by the factory.
Integration tests could cover additional edge cases for invalid timecode parameter formats.
Audio seeking logic in PodcastPlayerView relies on standard HTML5 media events; adding explicit fallback error handlers for network audio stream drops would improve resilience.
Contract specification file is created in docs/contracts/podcast-api.yaml rather than updating existing shared OpenAPI doc.
Intake submission validation error responses could provide more detailed field-level validation messages.
The contract validation python script requires PyYAML which must be present in the verification execution environment.
QA verification output file is placed in .eneik/records which is stripped automatically prior to main merge.
Playwright E2E test builds and spawns a local vite preview server; ensuring port 4173 is unallocated in concurrent CI runners is recommended.
Admin dashboard API contract defines bearer auth token schemas which should be paired with HTTPS enforcement in production config.
